title: Mpango ERP inventory protocol deltas
description: Reviewed, owned, single-use authorizations for changes to frozen inventory identity and to the governance core. Anti-replay: a delta only authorizes the comparison whose base_sha it carries; historical deltas (byte-identical to the baseline copy) cannot be reused. Kind-precise: removal/rename/reorder/reclassify authorize node identity and status changes by affected_ids; governance authorizes governance-core path changes by affected_paths (renames list both the previous and the new id in affected_ids).

affected_ids.description: node or debt ids this delta authorizes; governance deltas may leave it empty

affected_paths.description: repository paths this delta covers (prefix match); required non-empty for kind=governance

base_sha.description: the comparison base commit this delta authorizes; must equal the validator's actual comparison base
